The impact of the described data breach is significant due to the sensitive nature of the compromised data. The breach exposed patient names, health insurance details, medical histories, and treatment information. This combination of personally identifiable information (PII) and protected health information (PHI) creates a high risk for both identity theft and insurance fraud. With 200,000 individuals affected, the potential for financial loss, emotional distress, and misuse of private health data is substantial.
